title: feat(enter): filter models usable with Quest Pollen
author: gggff123
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds a local-only `Quest Pollen models` switch to the Models page.
- Uses the canonical `isPaidOnly` predicate across scopes, categories, and search.
- Updates filtered empty states without URL or local storage persistence.

Fixes #11436

gist.headline: Find the quest-friendly flowers
gist.blurb: The Models page now has a Quest Pollen switch for browsing models available without paid-only access. A small filter, for when the model garden has become pleasantly enormous.
gist.summary: Added a local-only "Quest Pollen models" switch on the Models page that filters scopes, categories, and search results using the canonical isPaidOnly predicate, with matching empty states.
gist.impact: People using Quest Pollen can quickly find usable models without changing the URL or saving a filter preference.
gist.visual_concept: Polli, wearing a tiny gardener hat and holding a seed packet labeled "Quest Pollen," stands beside a cozy model garden where available code-flowers are brightly blooming and paid-only flowers sit behind a gentle little sign. A retro terminal and a chunky toggle switch show that Polli is filtering the garden rather than changing it.
